title: Dry Fountain and Opposed Bench Rest Plaza
description: One static public-park rest-plaza scene, counted as one scene and zero new independent models. One complete unchanged dry two-tier fountain occupies the center of a closed circular scene-only paving slab. Two whole original Tideway slatted benches stand opposite each other, facing inward through exact quarter-turn rotations at unit scale. The complete original GLB mesh sets, oriented triangles and per-face solid PBR assignments are embedded in the self-contained generator; only declared rigid placements and collision-safe name prefixes are added before normal float32 export. Open paving separates both seats from the central basin and continues around the fountain. Four meshes and six materials; the original benchmark bench is one joined GLB mesh and remains one whole mesh per instance. No water, animation, humans, functioning fountain, ergonomic/accessibility evaluation, navigation logic, construction plan, drainage, load or safety certification.
